units.source_text: 坐在王叶草地上是十分惬意的。

en.t: Sitting on the clover-covered grass was extremely pleasant.

units.source_text: 三叶草的柔和的叶子吸收着阳光，

en.t: The soft leaves of the clover were soaking up the sunlight,

units.source_text: 那细小的影子撒满一地，看起来这一带恍如从地面轻轻漂起。

en.t: and their tiny shadows were scattered all over the ground, making the whole area seem as if it were gently floating up from the earth.

units.source_text: 柏木坐着与走路时不同，和其他的同学别无二致。

en.t: When Kashiwagi was sitting, unlike when he walked, he looked no different from the other students.

units.source_text: 不仅如此，他那苍白的脸上洋溢着一种可怕的美。

en.t: More than that, his pale face was filled with a kind of terrifying beauty.

units.source_text: 肉体上的残废者同美貌的女子一样，具有无敌的美。

en.t: A person physically disabled, like a beautiful woman, possesses an invincible beauty.

units.source_text: 残废者和美貌的女人都是疲于被人观看，顿于被人观看的存在。

en.t: Both the disabled person and the beautiful woman are beings worn out by being looked at, dulled by being looked at.

units.source_text: 他被穷追，就以存在本身来回观观看者。

en.t: When he is cornered, he looks back at the observer with his very existence.
In the end, the one who gazes wins.

units.source_text: 正在吃盒饭的柏木垂下眼帘，

en.t: Kashiwagi, eating his boxed lunch, lowered his eyes,

units.source_text: 我感觉到他的眼睛看遍了自己周围的世界。

en.t: and I felt that his eyes had taken in the whole world around him.
